name: North-star: Heatmap

queries.name: main
queries.sql:
SELECT toHour(OccurredAt) AS hour,
  toDayOfWeek(OccurredAt) AS dow,
  uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM traces
WHERE OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
GROUP BY hour, dow
ORDER BY dow, hour
